We use SvelteKit adapter-static (not Vercel's SvelteKit auto-detection), which writes to build/ — Vercel defaults to dist/ and fails 'No Output Directory named dist' (M5). Pin the build here so it's repo-config, not a per-project dashboard setting. Vercel project Root Directory must be app/web; served at the domain root, so BASE_PATH stays empty.
